known_gaps.title: Correction: the stations do have players
known_gaps.why: The recorded gap said the named stations had no embeds to demonstrate the geography claim. The guide already carries two collections for exactly that: one set each from NTS, Rinse FM and The Lot Radio, and a second block of Kiosk Radio, Seoul Community Radio and Manila Community Radio. Only Radio Rudina and Boxout.fm are named without a player, and 'three hours from three cities' is a deliberate limit rather than an omission.
